chapter_seo_title: Chapter 609: Reunion of the Skeleton Kings and a Desperate Breakthrough
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen reaches the peak of Half-Ancestor. The three skeleton kings return and join the assault on the wounded Peerless King Meng Degang, who loses an arm to a true Heavenly Stele.
og_description: Xiao Chen ascends to Half-Ancestor Ninth Heaven and reunites with the three skeleton kings, leading to a fierce clash with the crippled Peerless King Meng Degang.
twitter_description: Xiao Chen reaches Half-Ancestor Ninth Heaven, reunites with old skeleton allies, and wounds the Peerless King with a Heavenly Stele.
